# Mike Mello

Stand-up comedian based in Raleigh, North Carolina, with 20+ years on the road.

## Identity

- Performing name: Mike Mello (also known as Mello Mike, Mike Mello Miller)
- Real name: Michael Miller
- Born in Virginia; spent ~25 years in Cary, NC; now based in Raleigh, NC
- Started his career at Charlie Goodnight's Comedy Club in Raleigh

## Career credits

- Two stand-up specials: *Incognegro* (2018, IMDB tt7971376) and *What's Seasoning?* (streaming on HITKOR)
- TV credit: *D.L. Hughley's Speakeasy: Comedy Overload* (2022)
- NBC Stand-Up Diversity Showcase finalist
- Heard on SiriusXM Radio
- Toured with Tracy Morgan and Russell Peters
- Opened for Dave Chappelle, Ralphie May, D.L. Hughley, and Damon Wayans
- IMDB: https://www.imdb.com/name/nm9610033/

## Press

- INDY Week 2023 profile by Craig Lindsey ("one of the most respected comedians in the community")
- Raleigh Magazine "Mellow Humor" feature, November 2018
- WRAL: "Mike Mello celebrates 15 years in stand-up"
- The Cary Podcast Episode 37 (July 2025)

- Booking, press, corporate, and private event inquiries: https://mikemello.com/contact
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mikemellomiller/
- X / Twitter: https://twitter.com/mikemellocomedy
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mello.m.miller/

## What Mike does

Mike Mello is a working stand-up comedian. He headlines comedy clubs, performs at festivals, books private and corporate events, and hosts. His style is laid-back and observational, with a smooth delivery shaped by 20+ years on stages from Raleigh to Los Angeles.
